name: packaging
description: Build and maintain agent skill marketplace repos: scaffold a new one, mirror an external one onto GHES (mirror-repo), rename it to convention, audit its layout, and refactor it into shape.

interface.shortDescription: Create, mirror, rename, audit, and refactor agent skill marketplace repos
interface.longDescription: Packaging bundles the five skills used to build and maintain skill marketplace repos: scaffold-repo scaffolds a new repo end to end, mirror-repo mirrors an existing external repo onto GHES, rename-repo moves an existing one onto the naming convention and fixes every hardcoded reference, structure-check audits a repo's layout read-only, and structure-refactor applies the fixes.
defaultPrompt: Package these skills into a new plugin marketplace repo.
